Module meant to initialize ‘Colbot’ along with loading its’ extensions.

This module contains the primary logic for the Colbot discord client, including custom command handling and automated event listeners. It utilizes the discord.py library as its base.

colbot.TOKEN

String token identifier needed to start the bot on Discord.

Type:

str

colbot.ID

Server ID needed to refresh ‘/’ commands on Discord.

Type:

int

colbot.intents

Discord object that defines what the bot can/cannot do.

Type:

discord.Intents

colbot.bot

Discord object that gets created from Colbot class that uses the ‘intents’ object above.

Type:

Colbot

colbot.initial_extensions

List containing the scripts that need to be connected to the bot on startup.

Type:

list[str]

colbot.test_guild

Discord object that contains the ID of my discord server for testing.

Type:

discord.Object
